text:
Maria: Heads-up: we saw ~12% drop in APAC throughput since 03:00 UTC — p99 RTT spikes + preemptible evictions. Need a shoulder capacity plan for next 72h.
Sunil: Saw the same. p99 RTT to our edge -> compute nodes jumped from ~40ms -> 140ms. Preemptible eviction rate up 0.5% -> 3% over last 2h.
Jordan: Any single-point infra issues or is this network churn?
Sunil: Mostly network churn between apac-edge and the GPU hosts, plus some scheduled maintenance in one AZ. Eviction blips line up with the RTT spikes.
Maria: Can we redispatch reserved GPUs from EU to APAC temporarily? How many GPU-hours to absorb likely peaks?
Jordan: Quick calc: baseline APAC demand ~180k tokens/sec. If peak +20% -> additional ~36k t/s. Our mix yields ~6k t/s per A100-equivalent -> ~6 GPUs. But concurrency and KV cache can reduce effective load ~15% -> ~5 GPUs. Add 2 GPUs for headroom -> 7 GPUs.
Kevin: From a cost angle: we have underutilized reserved capacity in EU 02:00-06:00 UTC. If we reroute 40 GPUs for 6h/day that's ~240 GPU-hours/day. Cross-region egress adds cost but still far cheaper than on-demand. Summary: redispatch looks cost-effective.
Anya: Caveat: EU reserved pool uses a slightly different kernel/quant profile for medium models. If we move nodes, warmup is required to avoid cold penalty on first requests.
Maria: Plan: redistribute a small tranche (10-12 GPUs), run KV warmups + synthetic traffic, monitor p99. Warmup sketch: run 5 tps for 5m per node to populate caches. That’s ~0.4 GPU-hours/node per warmup.
Sunil: Also update routing policy so APAC region still preferred but overflow allowed with a short-circuit flag. Example config: `route_overflow: { policy: "region-first", allow_cross_region: true, max_cross_region_concurrency: 200 }`
OpsBot: incident-tracker created: INC-2026-045 (APAC-RTT-burst). Assigned: Sunil, Maria.
Jordan: Also account for preemptible eviction risk: add a 20% eviction buffer. If we need 7 GPUs effective, allocate 7 / (1 - 0.2) ~= 9 GPUs -> round to 10-12 for safety.
Kevin: Cost quick math: cross-region tag adds ~$0.05/hr per GPU egress. For 12 GPUs * 6h = 72 GPU-hours -> egress delta ~$3.6/day, negligible vs on-demand.
Ops: I'll queue a redispatch and warmup. Command I'll run: `redispatch --from eu-reserved --to apac-shared --count 12 --duration 36h --warmup "5tps:5m" --tag shoulder-redispatch`
OpsBot: Action queued: redispatch job ID rd-2417890000-01.
Ops: ETA ~8m, will post when warmup done and initial metrics captured.
Maria: After roll, capture: p99 latency, tokens/sec, per-node GPU utilization, eviction count, and cost delta. If we see repeat patterns over next 72h we should consider rebalancing reserved commitments.
Anya: I'll add a short eval: baseline vs post-redispatch sample on the same prompt set to catch quality regressions from kernel mismatch.
Kevin: Sounds good. Ops, please also set an alert if eviction_rate > 2% for 15m or p99 > 200ms for 10m so we can auto-escalate.
Ops: Alert rules created: `eviction_rate > 2% for 15m` and `p99_latency > 200ms for 10m` on APAC nodes.
Maria: Thanks — will check back in 2h with post-warmup numbers.
Jordan: One more note: document the wiggle-room (temporary pool) in the runbook under "shoulder-redispatch" so on-call knows the intended rollback and cost thresholds.
Maria: Agreed. I'll update the runbook and tag the PR after we confirm metrics.
